program_solutions:
(rule!
  ;; Only red connected components are candidates; every other color is a distractor.
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0))])
    (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
           (rs (map first cells))
           (cs (map second cells)))
      (cond
        ;; Recolor the two horizontal extremes; preserve every interior cell.
        [(and (>= (length cells) 2) (= (apply min rs) (apply max rs)))
         (let ((r (first rs)))
           (paint-cells out
                        (list (list r (apply min cs)) (list r (apply max cs)))
                        8))]
        ;; Recolor the two vertical extremes; bent red components fall through unchanged.
        [(and (>= (length cells) 2) (= (apply min cs) (apply max cs)))
         (let ((c (first cs)))
           (paint-cells out
                        (list (list (apply min rs) c) (list (apply max rs) c))
                        8))]
        [else out]))))
